scope: Hindi, Thompson Salish, and Korean contrast-source audit for LING406 Module II; scratch assets only; no repository course files edited
global_limit: These are teaching demonstrations derived from source-annotated phonetic recordings. They are not the original Werker–Tees or Ventureyra study stimuli and are not validated research stimuli. Source chart/table labels establish category/word mappings; no independent native-speaker listening panel was available.

hindi.status: Native dental/retroflex CV onset excerpts produced; replaces mismatched alphabet-context clips
hindi.teaching_target: Hindi voiceless unaspirated dental /t̪a/ versus retroflex /ʈa/ before the same vowel
hindi.mapping_evidence: HTML imagemap maps the dental voiceless unaspirated table cell at x269..329,y108..156 to hindi6.wav, and post-alveolar/retroflex corresponding cell x351..439,y111..151 to hindi10.wav. Table glosses: beat and postpone.

derived_assets.pitch_method: Retained native source F0; no pitch/formant/time conversion
Retained native source F0; no pitch/formant/time conversion

hindi.method: Excise source samples [0,260ms], before lateral transition near 300ms. Retain original release (~45ms) and early vowel formant transition. Normalize RMS to 0.20 over source [100,240ms], apply identical 8ms raised-cosine final fade, add 40ms leading + 80ms trailing silence. Output mono 16kHz 16-bit PCM, 380ms. Native F0 retained; no vowel replacement, English phonemes, TTS, spectral warping, or duration/pitch resynthesis.

acoustic_checks.formant_check: Vowel F1 remains roughly 614–674Hz at 200–250ms; lateral transition shows F1 falling to ~400–435Hz by 350ms. Cropping at 260ms excludes final lateral and its strongest transition. Lower initial F3 in retroflex source is consistent with source place labels but is not independent category validation.

hindi.suggested_context: Same vowel; dental versus retroflex stop. New native CV excerpts for hearing the contrast, not the original 1984 test recordings.
claim_limits: Do not label as original experiment stimuli.
The underlying sources are words; the main players are gated consonant–vowel onsets, not complete original utterances.
Do not claim exact original study duration/pitch/voice; original study specifications were not reconstructed.

korean.method: Complete, unchanged original source WAVs. Conversion to MP3 may be used for web playback; preserve originals/hashes. No clipping or phoneme replacement needed.

salish.status: Exact matched Thompson Salish /kʼi–qʼi/ remains unavailable; do not present current mismatched words as that stimulus pair
salish.teaching_target: Thompson Salish voiceless ejective velar versus uvular stop before /i/: /kʼi/ versus /qʼi/
salish.source_credit: Recordings made by Janet Werker, loaned to Louis Goldstein, hosted by Dani Byrd at USC
salish.why_current_pair_fails: The documented examples are t9.wav /kʼexem/ and te4.wav /qʼa/. They have different following vowels and word lengths. Neither is /kʼi/ or /qʼi/ and they cannot be relabeled as such.

checked_resources.result: Public source listing includes t1..t17, te1..te6 and category charts thomvel.pdf/thomuv.pdf; charts identify different-vowel examples. No verified matched /i/ pair or per-word transcription for remaining audio was found.
Accessible Montana Salish table uses nonmatching words/vowels, labialized velars and uvulars, e.g. /kʷʼ.../ versus /qʼ.../. Different Salish language, no matched /kʼi,qʼi/ pair. Do not substitute.
Author laboratory site returned CAPTCHA; no attempt to bypass.

checked_resources.resource: VocalTractLab 2.4 bundled speaker presets / local source
checked_resources.result: No validated ejective /kʼ,qʼ/ gesture preset. Existing pulmonic stop segments plus glottal closure do not establish glottalic ejective articulation, oral pressure or verified release acoustics.

checked_resources.resource: Kokoro/Piper ordinary TTS and English phoneme voices
checked_resources.result: No verified Thompson Salish model/ejective inventory available; plain English ki/qi cannot represent this contrast.

salish.safe_integration: Keep the current authentic archive words only as clearly titled, supplementary different-word ejective examples, with literal /kʼexem/ and /qʼa/ titles. Remove them from the principal matched ki/qi comparison and show a precise text notice that the exact recorded pair is not yet supplied. Do not fabricate a validated replica.
salish.remaining_requirement: Obtain author/lab original recordings, a documented native Thompson matched /i/ recording, or an ejective-capable synthesis model calibrated to source timing/formant/laryngeal cues and checked by a native speaker or phonetician.
